rows.en: Touya: "All right, let's go!"
Aurelie: "We can leave the village to Arthur and the other one.
It'll be fine. We've gotta do something about Cain!"
Fain: "All right! Princess, let us go
and cut off trouble at its root!"
Celica: "...Be careful. Cain's mech
outperforms even Major Rest's Zaxas!"
Fain: "Even a superior weapon cannot show its true worth
unless its pilot can master it!
He is nothing to fear! Dahahahaha!"
Kasumi: "Don't get careless, Fain."
Fain: "Heh... Don't worry! I will protect you!"
Kasumi: "That wasn't what I meant..."
Touya: "H-hey, are you sure you're all right?"
Melissa: "There's no need to worry.
Ahti remembers me perfectly well.
And this one seems excited because it's been so long."
Touya: "I don't really get it, but you're all right, then?"
Melissa: "Yes. Let's hurry.
Everyone's fighting, aren't they?"
Touya: "All right, then..."
Steinies: "...I'm a lucky man.
I get to test the new model and pay them back for last time...
Heh heh heh heh..."
Touya: "Hey, what's going on?"
Steinies: "...We meet again. I'm glad
we could be reunited so soon..."
Touya: "You!"
Steinies: "I'll have to thank my informant...
Heh heh heh... Now, I'll show you Bargion's power."
Touya: "Ugh... What terrible timing..."
Yamato: "What are we going to do?!"
Defeat Steinies
Go defeat Cain
Touya: "We'll deal with these guys first!"
Steinies: "There are Spirit Mechs here...
A perfect excuse to execute Grad's woman and daughter..."
Touya: "What the hell are you talking about?"
Steinies: "I'll finish you lot off,
then burn that village to the ground..."
Fain: "What?! Are you insane?!"
Steinies: "I'm always serious...
Now, shall we get started...?"
Touya: "Like hell I'll let you!"
Ai: "Touya. I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time,
I will act on my own judgment."
Clovis: "I'll act alone. I'm counting on you to handle that side."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I still can't put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I do not intend to follow your orders.
I shall act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice
does not yet dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
Therefore, I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Gen: "I'll show you how much I've grown!
So I'll do things my own way. See you!"
Melvi: "Big Brother, Melvi has an idea.
So I'll move on my own."
Melissa: "This time, I'll act on my own for a while."
Kururu: "I'm gonna fight however I like."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow your orders properly, Touya.
So I'll do things freely this time, okay?"
Fain: "Right! Leave this to us!
Don't worry. With me here, there's no way
we could lose to that bastard!"
Aurelie: "Don't get careless.
That man isn't all talk."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan! Good luck!"
Touya: "Don't push yourself too hard either!"
Kasumi: "Okay. See you when you get back."
Celica: "After all we went through to save Tix...
I'll protect him!"
Touya: "Celica! I'm counting on you to support everyone!"
Celica: "Leave it to me. Be careful, Touya!"
Steinies: "Impossible... My Bargion...
Damn you..."
Ai: "Sorry! Cain got away."
Yamato: "What are we going to do, Touya?
At this rate, Oswald will..."
Touya: "We've got no choice but to go back...
I won't let that kid get killed because of us!"
Yamato: "Do you have a plan?!"
Touya: "...No."
Yamato: "Oh, dear..."
Touya: "There's Steinies to worry about too!
Anyway, we're going back to the village!"

review_batches.context: Entire 88-row member read: Cain approach, optional Melissa/Ahti readiness, Steinies interception, two choices, character-by-character independent-action alternatives and battle outcome. Includes the following return-to-village conversation.
review_batches.decisions: Keep relative Cain/Zaxas performance as Celica's warning versus Fain's confidence, Ahti personification, Bargion name, unnamed informant and threats to Grad's family/village. The twelve independent-action reactions are source alternatives, not a simultaneous party-wide mutiny. Preserve each distinct reason/tone, Tix protection, choices and handoff direction.

row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00235.l00: Arthur is named but the other village defender is not. Keep the other one neutral rather than filling in Clovis or a gender from guesswork.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o002aa.l00: Cain's mech outperforms Rest's Zaxas, according to Celica. Fain counters with pilot mastery, not a denial of that technical comparison.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o0035d.l00: Fain misreads Kasumi's warning as needing protection. Preserve her next correction rather than turning this into a mutual romantic agreement.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o003ea.l01: Ahti remembers Melissa and seems excited is her personification; no newly proved AI recognition system or restored-memory mechanism.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o005fc.l00: Informant is not identified. Do not insert a name or equate the report with a proven betrayal by Maki.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o0067e.l00: Two player choices: defeat Steinies here or go defeat Cain. Preserve the different targets and movement intent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o006c0.l01: Grad's woman and daughter is Steinies's contemptuous threat; preserve execution and do not narrate actual deaths.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o0071e.l01: Village burning is threatened, not already accomplished. Keep the full force of burn to the ground.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o0074f.l00: Fain asks whether he is sane, Steinies answers that he is serious. Keep the deliberately skewed reply.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o007d5.l00: Start of separate conditional independent-action reactions; do not force all twelve into a single conversation in which everyone abandons Touya.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o0085e.l00: Clovis asks Touya to handle the other side while he acts alone. Do not reverse the handoff.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o008a2.l00: Aurelie explicitly does not yet entrust her life to Touya. Do not soften into a purely tactical preference.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00987.l00: Fain's justice-based refusal remains his exaggerated moral stance, distinct from Leone's later lack of confidence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00a63.l00: Melvi refers to herself by name and calls Touya Big Brother affectionately. No biological brother relationship added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00b32.l00: Leone worries about properly following instructions; she is not making Fain's moral accusation or Aurelie's distrust statement.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00b87.l00: Contrasting leave-it-to-us branch is retained separately from refusals. No invented explanation forces both responses into one moment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00c60.l00: Tix has been saved in this branch and Celica vows to protect him. Do not erase the branch fact to fit the alternate Cain-escaped outcome.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00c8f.l00: Touya asks Celica to support everyone. She agrees; do not reverse who provides support.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00db9.l00: Bargion failure is Steinies's reaction. No new explosion, pilot death or ejection is narrated.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00e0b.l00: Cain escaped in this outcome, distinct from the preceding successful Tix-protection branch.

review_batches.context: Final eight rows: unfinished Oswald warning, Touya's resolve to prevent a death despite no plan and return to the village. Full member examined before drafting.
review_batches.decisions: Do not complete the Oswald warning with an unprinted action. That kid remains gender-neutral and unnamed in this row; do not guess the threatened person's identity from a later branch. Keep explicit being killed because of us, Touya admitting he has no plan and Steinies as a further concern. Actual end-of-member slice.

row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00e2b.l01: Oswald is named but what he may do is intentionally unfinished. Keep the ellipsis; do not invent a threat verb.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00e55.l01: That kid is an unresolved source reference in this limited scene. Retain neutral familiar wording, no gender/name, and the explicit killing/causal concern. Flag identity for broader-route meaning review.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00ea8.l00: Touya admits he has no plan. Do not supply a covert tactic or rewrite his answer as confidence.
row_decisions.scenario.s_015.o00ebc.l00: Written dejected exclamation is translated as Oh, dear rather than left as Japanese sound spelling.
